How to use Brand Prospector

What this tool is: a live view of which brands are running custom/branded content on competitor publishers (Wall Street Journal, FT, Bloomberg, Economist, Forbes, Fortune, BBC, Euronews, and more) — so you can see who has budget and appetite for this kind of content, and whether Reuters is already in the mix.

Default view — Hot Prospects: the table opens filtered to EMEA, active in the last 90 days, and not yet a Reuters client. Switch to All brands in the View filter to see the full dataset.

Filters:

  • Search — brand or parent advertiser name
  • Geography — Global, US, Europe, MENA, EMEA, APAC
  • Sector — narrow to a specific industry
  • Publisher — show only brands active on a specific competitor
  • Recency — All time vs. Active 90d
  • Relationship — All / Clients / Prospects
  • View — Hot Prospects (the daily shortlist) vs. All brands

Reading the table:

  • A numbered badge marks each row's position in the current sort
  • An orange Reuters Client badge means the brand already runs content with us
  • Articles is total activity over the rolling ~12 months; Last 90d is the more current momentum signal
  • Click any row to expand it — publisher breakdown, recent articles with links, and a quick summary panel

Data: refreshed weekly from Contalto. Use the ⟳ Refresh Data button in the header to upload a new export yourself — no need to go through anyone else to keep this current.

Refresh competitor data

Upload this week's Contalto export to replace the dataset in this page. This works the same way the weekly refresh always has — full replacement, not a merge — so make sure the export covers the full rolling 12 months and the usual 18-publisher watchlist.

If you skip this, the tool reuses the Reuters-client flags already in the current page.
